advisories.message: Demographic groups overlap across categories and may overlap within a category (active_duty can be a subset of military_connected). Read the dataset's definitions and non_additive declarations. Use the published `all` total when available, never add it to its subgroups. Counts reconcile only for complete, disjoint groups; subgroup rates generally do not add to the overall rate.
